source.author: ov
source.text: Subruit haec aevi demoliturque prioris robora, fletque Milon senior, cum spectat inanes illos, qui fuerant solidorum mole tororum Herculeis similes!
source.text_original: Subruit haec aevi demoliturque prioris / robora, fletque Milon senior, cum spectat inanes / (illos, qui fuerant solidorum mole tororum / Herculeis similes!)
source.text_english: It undermines these and demolishes the strong frames of the earlier age, and old Milo weeps when he looks at those empty things, which had been solid masses of couches, resembling Hercules!

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: at tibi collectas solvit iam fibula vestes ostenditque umeros fortes spatiumque superbi pectoris Herculeis aequum, Meleagre, lacertis.
reuse.text_original: at tibi collectas solvit iam fibula vestes / ostenditque umeros fortes spatiumque superbi / pectoris Herculeis aequum, Meleagre, lacertis.
reuse.text_english: But for you the buckle now loosens the gathered garments and reveals your strong shoulders and the expanse of your proud chest, equal to Hercules’ arms, Meleager.
